Release-Date: 2026-11-11

### Fixed

- [SPS-010] Trust the independent Linux publisher alongside the existing laptop
  key and select signed SDP2.2.1 through an immutable bootstrap dependency.
- [SPS-010] Preserve the thin-client arguments, streams, cwd, exit status and
  offline workflow. Linux amd64 artifacts use the portable v1 CPU baseline.

### Migration

Upgrade the extension before selecting Linux-signed descriptors;0.2.2 does not
know the new key. Client installation does not itself upgrade project SDP folders.

SDPTool 2.3.0 — one shared runtime

The extension now contains the exact signed canonical SDPTool executable. There
is no runtime bootstrap or second engine download. Product version2.3.0 is separate
from the retained sdptool/0.2 JSON schema.

For an existing extension:

```sh
gh extension upgrade sdp
gh sdp setup
```

For a new installation, run `gh extension install Hans-Einar/gh-sdp`, then
`gh sdp setup`. Setup registers `$HOME/.local/bin/sdptool` once. Later extension
upgrades replace that same engine for direct clients, including XFMD0.11. Local
browsing requires neither GitHub CLI nor credentials/network after installation.
Add `$HOME/.local/bin` to PATH for shell use; setup diagnoses conflicts and older
PATH installations rather than overwriting them. XFMD uses the registered path.

All source SDUI preview/check/native prototype commands are reachable through
`gh sdp sdui`; the native prototype payload travels inside the same engine.
Activities and readable producer-owned SDL viewpoints are included. Project
Framework installation/upgrades remain separate explicit operations.

Canonical source:774e150774d184d0604ae78f274586eeb2bad495.
Engine SHA256:2cfcf12f8bfb0d6fa8d11391db874f68d9bc9210c85974ff3cecee50f915ced6.
Distribution source:1753a11ffcbda3d6fd563456ee70db3c77e8d6c4.
Linux amd64 is the qualified platform. Native prototype launch needs OS GUI
libraries; the XFMD0.11 RPM declares those dependencies.

GitHub CLI owns binary replacement. If an interrupted download leaves a broken
extension and forced upgrade does not refetch, use the documented remove/reinstall
procedure with a fresh gh HTTP cache. Direct consumers never silently select an
older engine. See the source README for the tested recovery and its limits.
"}

SDPTool 2.3.0 — one shared runtime

The extension now contains the exact signed canonical SDPTool executable. There
is no runtime bootstrap or second engine download. Product version2.3.0 is separate
from the retained sdptool/0.2 JSON schema.

For an existing extension:

```sh
gh extension upgrade sdp
gh sdp setup
```

For a new installation, run `gh extension install Hans-Einar/gh-sdp`, then
`gh sdp setup`. Setup registers `$HOME/.local/bin/sdptool` once. Later extension
upgrades replace that same engine for direct clients, including XFMD0.11. Local
browsing requires neither GitHub CLI nor credentials/network after installation.
Add `$HOME/.local/bin` to PATH for shell use; setup diagnoses conflicts and older
PATH installations rather than overwriting them. XFMD uses the registered path.

All source SDUI preview/check/native prototype commands are reachable through
`gh sdp sdui`; the native prototype payload travels inside the same engine.
Activities and readable producer-owned SDL viewpoints are included. Project
Framework installation/upgrades remain separate explicit operations.

Canonical source:774e150774d184d0604ae78f274586eeb2bad495.
Engine SHA256:2cfcf12f8bfb0d6fa8d11391db874f68d9bc9210c85974ff3cecee50f915ced6.
Distribution source:1753a11ffcbda3d6fd563456ee70db3c77e8d6c4.
Linux amd64 is the qualified platform. Native prototype launch needs OS GUI
libraries; the XFMD0.11 RPM declares those dependencies.

GitHub CLI owns binary replacement. If an interrupted download leaves a broken
extension and forced upgrade does not refetch, use the documented remove/reinstall
procedure with a fresh gh HTTP cache. Direct consumers never silently select an
older engine. See the source README for the tested recovery and its limits.
"}
